retrievalProfile.description: A multi-paneled layout featuring high-contrast halftone portraits against a vibrant red backdrop, set over a motion-blurred blue-grey texture with a black industrial graphic block.
excludeWhen: soft pastel color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A composite image consisting of two rectangular portrait frames stacked vertically on the left, featuring high-contrast, grainy photography with intense red backgrounds. The entire composition sits atop a background of horizontal blue and grey motion-blurred streaks. To the right, a solid black vertical rectangle contains red geometric typography and a circular industrial-style emblem.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical stacking of portrait frames against a dynamic motion-blurred background
High-contrast red portrait backgrounds vs. cool blue-grey background streaks
Geometric black graphic block balancing the organic forms of the portraits
Halftone texture in imagery contrasting with clean vector-like graphic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two medium-shot portraits stacked on the left third; a vertical graphic block occupying the right third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black graphic block on the right acts as the primary weight, while the top portrait serves as the focal entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye moves from the top-left portrait down to the bottom-left, then across to the graphic block on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The motion-blurred background acts as active negative space, providing directional energy.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Steel blue and grey (background motion streaks)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant crimson red (portrait backgrounds and graphic elements)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds against desaturated, mid-value blues; extreme value contrast in portraits.

composition.position: Top and bottom of the black block

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single geometric family used for all text to maintain industrial consistency.
graphicDevices: Central slab-serif 'I' character inside the emblem

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the square, industrial 90s tech aesthetic.
Provides the necessary geometric rigidity and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a background of horizontal motion-blurred streaks in steel blue and grey. Place two rectangular frames on the left, each containing a high-contrast, grainy portrait of a young man with a saturated red background. Leave a vertical space on the right for a graphic overlay.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a solid black vertical rectangle on the right. Inside, place a red circular gear-like emblem with a slab-serif 'I' in the center. Position geometric sans-serif text in red above and below the emblem, aligned to the center.

verificationChecks: Is the background motion blur strictly horizontal?
Are the portraits high-contrast with a grainy, halftone-like texture?
Is the red in the portraits and the graphic block consistent?
Is the typography a clean, geometric sans-serif?

adjustableVariables: Width of the black graphic block
Specific hue of the red accent
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Strong color contrast between red and blue
Visible film grain or halftone texture in portraits
Sharp, clean edges on the graphic block
avoid: Blurry or soft edges on the text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the portraits are stacked vertically with equal spacing.
Verify the black block is perfectly rectangular and vertically oriented.
Check that the red text is legible against the black background.
Confirm the background streaks are predominantly horizontal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [motion-blurred background] + [high-contrast halftone portraits on red] + [geometric black graphic block with red sans-serif type].
